title: Pulled-back consecutive adic tower transition

proof.text: Construct the canonical derived scalar-extension/pullback comparison for the quotient map using the pro-etale ring restriction direct-image adjunction and the left-adjoint uniqueness API. Evaluate its inverse at the upper level.
Map the supplied consecutive normalization isomorphism of the adic tower through the pulled-back lower-level derived functor and compose it with the preceding comparison.

mathlib_searches.results: No existing declaration gives this consecutive quotient substep; it is a strict component of the parent transport.

lean.statement:
theorem adicTowerPullback_consecutive_transition_iso
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ X)
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (M : AdicTower X d) (n : ℕ) (W : Y.Etale) (_w : W.left) :
    Nonempty
      ((pbcDerivedExtend ((adicTowerInverseImage (W.hom ≫ g)).map
        (pbcAdicQuotient X d (n + 1) n (Nat.le_succ n)))).obj
        ((adicTowerPullback (W.hom ≫ g)
          ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op (n + 1)))).obj (M.level (n + 1))) ≅
      (adicTowerPullback (W.hom ≫ g)
        ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj (M.level n))
